subject: Shuttle timing and small favor
text:
Dear Professor,

I hope you are having a productive week. I am writing about the campus visit next Thursday and wanted to confirm one small detail with you. Our shared shuttle will leave from the library side entrance at 9:05 a.m., which is a few minutes earlier than the original plan because the afternoon room reservation was tightened.

Could you kindly ask your department colleague to hold the equipment crate at the reception desk until we arrive? We will sign for it when we reach the building, so it should not cause any delay. If a signature is required earlier in the day, please let me know how I can arrange that.

Thank you for your patience with the scheduling changes. Please tell me if the revised time creates any difficulty on your end.
